question: PSPN is related to OROM in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, YBYW is related to XAXV. To which of the given options is QTQO related, following the same logic?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d4d221f1b6376e2f723dfe1f944a93ba1b554fca28f95b5f7220d8e02473ae0.png]

For, PSPN is related to OROM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eac837858d1a2494f50ff79f78f0540bd4522d996dd88e5a9884dcfe8bea48e.png] 

And YBYW is related to XAXV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c5672712e198327922027935079e4f1bf17ef1da7c8b795684a9573f45647aa.png] 

Similarly, QTQO is related to PSPN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a216c232bdfedc76918dc44e2ca3ae681dbd35df126a1ffaf79abc463cc7b4ab.png]
